title: Enforce the complete strict browser CI matrix
summary: Generate both hosted browser matrices from the authoritative inventory and reject skipped tests through the strict smoke wrapper.
reason: Remediate P1 AUDIT-FIND-W10-003. Both hosted workflows hard-code only 23 of the 34 browser-smoke modules and invoke raw unittest, which treats skipped browser tests as success.
behavior_before: The phase and deep-audit browser jobs execute a stale literal selector subset and accept unittest skips as passing job evidence.
behavior_after: Each workflow obtains all selectors from browser_smoke_inventory and executes each selector through Invoke-WebViewBrowserSmokeUnittest without allowing skips.
tests_added: tests/python/tooling/test_browser_smoke_inventory.py: complete selector resolution and strict dynamic workflow matrix contract.
manual_validation: Pre-fix reproduction - inventory reports 34 modules and 42 selectors, while the focused regression fails because both workflows bypass it and two required-selector assertions use stale method names.
Focused browser inventory/workflow regression - passed: 5 tests and both workflow subtests; all 42 selectors resolve through unittest.
Strict browser wrapper behavior - passed: 18 tests including fail-on-skip, prerequisite failure, timeout, and no-mutation finalizer cases.
CI provisioning and native failure propagation regressions - passed: 9 tests.
Workflow YAML parsing, focused ruff, py_compile, and git diff --check - passed.
Project index and feature map generator check modes, architecture guardrails, naming lint, and GitHub audit spine config - passed.
Focused audit/browser/CI policy set - passed: 23 tests.
ai_guardrail postflight - batch-local checks passed; only separate finding-backed AUDIT-FIND-COV-001, AUDIT-FIND-DEP-001, and AUDIT-FIND-W12-ACTIVE-001 remain, with 0 god-file errors.
validate_changes --require-worktree-coverage - passed before completion: 1123 packets valid.
rollback_plan: Restore the literal workflow matrices and raw unittest invocations, restore the prior regression expectations, and retain this packet as incomplete evidence if rollback occurs.
notes: Finding disposition before remediation: confirmed against current workflow bytes and the immutable audit evidence. Invariant: all authoritative browser smokes must run in hosted CI, and missing browser prerequisites or unittest skips are not passing evidence. Required validation: inventory completeness and unittest resolution, workflow contract regression, strict-wrapper behavior, YAML parsing, relevant generated/architecture checks, and strict packet worktree coverage. Representative real-media validation is not required because this batch changes CI orchestration and tooling tests only. Independent validation used the separate browser-wrapper harness suite to prove strict skip, missing-prerequisite, timeout, and no-test outcomes independently of the workflow string contract. A hosted GitHub workflow dispatch was not run because it would mutate external CI state; local evidence proves discovery of 34 modules/42 selectors and exact strict-wrapper consumption.
